title: Ask a hotel for a lower room rate with an agent
summary: A poster says a Grok-based bot emailed their hotel and got the nightly rate cut from $330 to $240, saving $90 a night.
agent_role: The bot wrote to the hotel and negotiated the rate; the human's setup and approvals are not described.
outcome: The author reports the rate dropped from $330 to $240 a night.
what_they_did: The poster had a bot built on Grok email their hotel to ask for a lower rate. They say the same bot earlier lined up their meetings at a trade conference.
how_it_went: They report the hotel cut the rate from $330 to $240 a night, saving $90 a night.
prompt: I have a hotel booking at [hotel name] in [city] for [dates] at [current nightly rate]. Draft a polite email to the hotel asking whether they can lower the rate. Mention [reason, e.g. a longer stay, a loyalty membership, or a lower price you found elsewhere]. Show me the draft and wait for my approval before sending anything. If they reply, summarize their offer and suggest a response, but don't accept or change the booking without my say-so.

curation.rationale: A genuine, relatable daily-life action (the agent emailed a hotel and negotiated a lower rate) with a concrete number, but very thin on how it was set up.
